_about: 0048-add1 §ب (Talal 14 October 09:23): «أذكار الصباح والمساء» (HadeethEnc category 301) as two lists, «أذكار الصباح» and «أذكار المساء». Each hadith goes to the list (or both) its own text names, the word it is built on in `basis`, verbatim from the text; `segments` are the indices of its entry in data/adhkar-highlights.json shown in that list (a list highlights its own wording where the text has it, and nothing is written that is not in the source). Shown once the coordinator has reviewed it (status «reviewed»; until then the app kept the one list). `night`: at the end of «أذكار المساء» under «من أذكار الليل» (the evening list runs from Asr to Fajr, the night within it), their description as it is.
_box: 0049 د: each dhikr of the two lists shows first a box with the words to say, the list's segments joined, verbatim and in order (worker/test/adhkar-split-0048.test.ts). `box` overrides them where a segment is not part of the same saying: 5490 in the evening, «وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ» is the ending said another time (قَالَ: وَمَرَّةً أُخْرَى), so the box holds the first saying only and the hadith below keeps both highlighted. `compose` (0049-add1 أ, Talal 14 October 13:28): 3008's morning box built in code from its three reviewed segments by the replacements the text and its explanation name («وإذا أصبح قال ذلك أيضا»; «ويبدل اليوم بالليلة … ويذكر الضمائر بعده»), each with its exact count, nothing else changed; `composeLine` the line under it. `quran` (0049-add1 ب): a dhikr that is reading the Quran takes its box from the app's own Mushaf data, by sura and ayat; `quranLinks` shows buttons to the reader for long suras; `read` our line «تقرأ…».

reviewed.note: الملحق 0048-add4 أ: راجعه حديثًا حديثًا، والكلمات من نصوصها، والتظليل صحيح؛ و6274 و65260 في «أذكار المساء» وحدها، في آخرها، تحت «من أذكار الليل»

basis.evening: ومن قالها من الليل … فمات قبل أن يصبح

basis.morning: خرج من عندها بكرة حين صلى الصبح

basis.evening: لم تصبه فجأة بلاء، حتى يصبح
